failures: mcp__PubMed__get_full_text_article returns text with citation markers stripped ('[]' or '()') and no reference list, so numbered citations cannot be mapped to references. Backward chasing was limited to works whose authors are printed in running text (Niknejad 2015, Kurwale 2013, Calderon 2020, Azab 2014). Every paraphysis/colloid-cyst-origin work so named was already held (Sjovall 1909, Fulton & Bailey 1929, Kappers 1955, Coxe & Luse 1964, Shuangshoti 1965, Tsuchida 1992, Ho & Garcia 1992, Mackenzie 1991, Nagaraju 2010, Cheng 1999, Akins 1996, Saarinen 2011, Ciric & Zivin 1975, Rakic & Yakovlev 1968, Hingwala 2008).

Empty full_text (scanned/PDF-only PMC records, abstract only): PMC7974047 (Armao 2000), PMC2492219 (Brocklehurst 1979), PMC7056001 and PMC8174970 (Kier 1999/2000), PMC1014422 (Mackenzie 1991), PMC1244323 (Sharp 1959), PMC5529892 (Mukherjee 2017), PMC7661083 (Khanpara 2020), PMC5835788 (Kiecker 2017), PMC7245524 (Alicelebic 2004), PMC1262943 (Hines 1921), PMC6704247 (Meyer 2019), PMC7725605, PMC2890798, PMC8335256 (New & Davis 1981), PMC3329239 (Aurboonyawat). PMC12482738 is a video-caption stub.

None of the held core/relevant records without a PMCID (66 PMIDs checked with convert_article_ids) has a PMC version; Rivas-Manzano 2022, Joven 2013, Nagaraju 2010, Hasunuma 2010 and Cevik 2025 have no PMCID, so their reference lists could not be read.

Vingert & Gonobobleva 2025 (Ontogenez) and the Isaacs et al. 2025 Thieme chapter are not indexed in PubMed (0 hits); their reference lists could only be seen as WebSearch snippet fragments. WebFetch of shop.thieme.in and ruralneuropractice.com failed with ENOTFOUND (not routed around).

Works named in the Vingert 2025 snippet and not confirmable in PubMed, hence NOT recorded: Dufaure & Hubert 1961 (Arch Anat Microsc Morphol Exp 50:309-328; lookup NOT_FOUND), Bergquist (Acta Zool 34, NOT_FOUND), Nowikoff 1910 (Z wiss Zool 96:118-207, garbled title), Moyer 1998 PhD thesis (Univ Adelaide), Bocharov 1988 book, Novikov 1910. No usable title or author list was printed for them.
Pre-1946 works named in the texts (Sjovall 1909, Fulton & Bailey 1929, Wallmann 1858, Bailey 1916, Warren 1917) return 0 PubMed hits; they are already held from wb-classical as web records.

mcp__PubMed__get_article_metadata silently returns only about 19-20 records when asked for 82; batches of 15-20 PMIDs are needed. The search_articles date_from filter appeared to be ignored when date_to is omitted (pre-2005 items returned).

find_related_articles (similarity, not citation) gave 293 not-held PMIDs across 4 core seeds; only about 55 titles were screened and all but Catala 1998 and Kimura 1988 were off-topic (generic choroid plexus physiology, tumours, ion transport). The remaining ~240 were not screened; an adequate screen would need further call batches.

records.title: Intraventricular noncolloid neuroepithelial cysts.
records.excerpt: Within lateral ventricles, these cysts are distinguished from colloid cysts by their large size, more posterior locations, and CSF-equivalent CT attenuation of their contents. Lack of contrast enhancement on CT and angiographic avascularity are also features. Fenestration in two cases and partial cyst excision in the third case relieved the predominant symptoms. The symptomatology and theories of histogenesis are reviewed and the differential diagnosis discussed.
records.note: Three lateral/fourth-ventricle neuroepithelial cysts differentiated from third-ventricle colloid cysts; reviews histogenesis theories (abstract does not name the paraphysis). PMC record has empty full text.

records.title: [A case of colloid cyst of the third ventricle].
records.authors: Kimura H, Fukushima T, Ohta T, Tomonaga M, Ishii K, Gotou K, Okudera T
records.excerpt: Colloid cysts of the third ventricle are rare, accounting for less than 1% of all intracranial neoplasms. However, its incidence will increase with increased use of CT scan and MRI. The symptomatology is principally acute or chronic hydrocephalus obstructing the foramen of Monro, and the origin of this cyst is controversial, neuroepithelial or endodermal.
records.note: Japanese case report: colloid cyst with cavum veli interpositi; authors favour an endodermal origin from electron microscopy. Paraphysis not named in abstract.

records.title: Embryonic and fetal development of structures associated with the cerebro-spinal fluid in man and other species. Part I: The ventricular system, meninges and choroid plexuses.
records.journal: Archives d'anatomie et de cytologie pathologiques
records.excerpt: The development of the ventricles, meninges, and choroid plexuses are discussed in this article. The central cavity of the neural tube is formed during neurulation, which occurs during the fourth gestational week.
records.note: Review of human and comparative embryology of the ventricular system and choroid plexuses; background for the dorsal-roof / choroid plexus context of the paraphysis. Abstract does not mention the paraphysis.
